055  private static int availableToCount(long available) {
056    // Top bit has to be set
057    if (available < 0) {
058      return 64;
059    }
060
061    int count = 0;
062
063    // Top bit not set, we will eventually get a 0 bit
064    while ((available & 0x1) != 0) {
065      count++;
066      available >>= 1;
067    }
068    return count;
069  }

138  private static String opModeToString(long id) {
139    if (id == 0) {
140      return "";
141    }
142    m_opModesMutex.lock();
143    try {
144      OpModeOption option = m_opModes.get(id);
145      if (option != null) {
146        return option.name;
147      }
148    } finally {
149      m_opModesMutex.unlock();
150    }
151    return "<" + id + ">";
152  }

154  private static class MatchDataSender {
155    private static final String SMART_DASHBOARD_TYPE = "DriverStation";
156
157    final StringPublisher gameData;
158    final StringPublisher eventName;
159    final IntegerPublisher matchNumber;
160    final IntegerPublisher replayNumber;
161    final IntegerPublisher matchType;
162    final BooleanPublisher alliance;
163    final IntegerPublisher station;
164    final IntegerPublisher allianceStation;
165    final StructPublisher<ControlWord> controlWord;
166    final StringPublisher opMode;
167    String oldEventName = "";
168    String oldGameData = "";
169    int oldMatchNumber;
170    int oldReplayNumber;
171    int oldMatchType;
172    boolean oldIsRedAlliance = true;
173    int oldStationNumber = 1;
174    int oldAllianceStation = 0;
175    final ControlWord oldControlWord = new ControlWord();
176    final ControlWord currentControlWord = new ControlWord();
177
178    MatchDataSender() {
179      var table = NetworkTableInstance.getDefault().getTable("DriverStation");
180      table
181          .getStringTopic(".type")
182          .publishEx(
183              StringTopic.TYPE_STRING, "{\"SmartDashboard\":\"" + SMART_DASHBOARD_TYPE + "\"}")
184          .set(SMART_DASHBOARD_TYPE);
185      gameData = table.getStringTopic("GameData").publish();
186      gameData.set("");
187      eventName = table.getStringTopic("EventName").publish();
188      eventName.set("");
189      matchNumber = table.getIntegerTopic("MatchNumber").publish();
190      matchNumber.set(0);
191      replayNumber = table.getIntegerTopic("ReplayNumber").publish();
192      replayNumber.set(0);
193      matchType = table.getIntegerTopic("MatchType").publish();
194      matchType.set(0);
195      alliance = table.getBooleanTopic("IsRedAlliance").publish();
196      alliance.set(true);
197      station = table.getIntegerTopic("StationNumber").publish();
198      station.set(1);
199      allianceStation = table.getIntegerTopic("AllianceStationID").publish();
200      allianceStation.set(0);
201      controlWord = table.getStructTopic("ControlWord", ControlWord.struct).publish();
202      controlWord.set(oldControlWord);
203      opMode = table.getStringTopic("OpMode").publish();
204      opMode.set("");
205    }
206
207    @SuppressWarnings("VariableDeclarationUsageDistance")
208    private void sendMatchData() {
209      AllianceStationID allianceID = DriverStationJNI.getAllianceStation();
210      final int stationNumber =
211          switch (allianceID) {
212            case BLUE_1, RED_1 -> 1;
213            case BLUE_2, RED_2 -> 2;
214            case BLUE_3, RED_3 -> 3;
215            case UNKNOWN -> 0;
216          };
217      final boolean isRedAlliance =
218          switch (allianceID) {
219            case BLUE_1, BLUE_2, BLUE_3 -> false;
220            case RED_1, RED_2, RED_3, UNKNOWN -> true;
221          };
222
223      String currentEventName;
224      String currentGameData;
225      int currentMatchNumber;
226      int currentReplayNumber;
227      int currentMatchType;
228      m_cacheDataMutex.lock();
229      try {
230        currentEventName = DriverStationBackend.m_matchInfo.eventName;
231        currentGameData = DriverStationBackend.m_gameData;
232        currentMatchNumber = DriverStationBackend.m_matchInfo.matchNumber;
233        currentReplayNumber = DriverStationBackend.m_matchInfo.replayNumber;
234        currentMatchType = DriverStationBackend.m_matchInfo.matchType;
235      } finally {
236        m_cacheDataMutex.unlock();
237      }
238      DriverStationJNI.getControlWord(currentControlWord);
239
240      if (oldIsRedAlliance != isRedAlliance) {
241        alliance.set(isRedAlliance);
242        oldIsRedAlliance = isRedAlliance;
243      }
244      if (oldStationNumber != stationNumber) {
245        station.set(stationNumber);
246        oldStationNumber = stationNumber;
247      }
248      if (oldAllianceStation != allianceID.ordinal()) {
249        allianceStation.set(allianceID.ordinal());
250        oldAllianceStation = allianceID.ordinal();
251      }
252      if (!oldEventName.equals(currentEventName)) {
253        eventName.set(currentEventName);
254        oldEventName = currentEventName;
255      }
256      if (!oldGameData.equals(currentGameData)) {
257        gameData.set(currentGameData);
258        oldGameData = currentGameData;
259      }
260      if (currentMatchNumber != oldMatchNumber) {
261        matchNumber.set(currentMatchNumber);
262        oldMatchNumber = currentMatchNumber;
263      }
264      if (currentReplayNumber != oldReplayNumber) {
265        replayNumber.set(currentReplayNumber);
266        oldReplayNumber = currentReplayNumber;
267      }
268      if (currentMatchType != oldMatchType) {
269        matchType.set(currentMatchType);
270        oldMatchType = currentMatchType;
271      }
272      if (!currentControlWord.equals(oldControlWord)) {
273        long currentOpModeId = currentControlWord.getOpModeId();
274        if (currentOpModeId != oldControlWord.getOpModeId()) {
275          opMode.set(opModeToString(currentOpModeId));
276        }
277        controlWord.set(currentControlWord);
278        oldControlWord.update(currentControlWord);
279      }
280    }
281  }

283  private static class JoystickLogSender {
284    JoystickLogSender(DataLog log, int stick, long timestamp) {
285      m_stick = stick;
286
287      m_logButtons = new BooleanArrayLogEntry(log, "DS:joystick" + stick + "/buttons", timestamp);
288      m_logAxes = new FloatArrayLogEntry(log, "DS:joystick" + stick + "/axes", timestamp);
289      m_logPOVs = new IntegerArrayLogEntry(log, "DS:joystick" + stick + "/povs", timestamp);
290
291      appendButtons(m_joystickButtons[m_stick], timestamp);
292      appendAxes(m_joystickAxes[m_stick], timestamp);
293      appendPOVs(m_joystickPOVs[m_stick], timestamp);
294    }
295
296    public void send(long timestamp) {
297      HALJoystickButtons buttons = m_joystickButtons[m_stick];
298      if (buttons.m_available != m_prevButtons.m_available
299          || buttons.m_buttons != m_prevButtons.m_buttons) {
300        appendButtons(buttons, timestamp);
301      }
302
303      HALJoystickAxes axes = m_joystickAxes[m_stick];
304      int available = axes.m_available;
305      boolean needToLog = false;
306      if (available != m_prevAxes.m_available) {
307        needToLog = true;
308      } else {
309        for (int i = 0; i < m_prevAxes.m_axes.length; i++) {
310          if (axes.m_axes[i] != m_prevAxes.m_axes[i]) {
311            needToLog = true;
312            break;
313          }
314        }
315      }
316      if (needToLog) {
317        appendAxes(axes, timestamp);
318      }
319
320      HALJoystickPOVs povs = m_joystickPOVs[m_stick];
321      available = m_joystickPOVs[m_stick].m_available;
322      needToLog = false;
323      if (available != m_prevPOVs.m_available) {
324        needToLog = true;
325      } else {
326        for (int i = 0; i < m_prevPOVs.m_povs.length; i++) {
327          if (povs.m_povs[i] != m_prevPOVs.m_povs[i]) {
328            needToLog = true;
329            break;
330          }
331        }
332      }
333      if (needToLog) {
334        appendPOVs(povs, timestamp);
335      }
336    }
337
338    void appendButtons(HALJoystickButtons buttons, long timestamp) {
339      int count = availableToCount(buttons.m_available);
340      if (m_sizedButtons == null || m_sizedButtons.length != count) {
341        m_sizedButtons = new boolean[count];
342      }
343      long buttonsValue = buttons.m_buttons;
344      for (int i = 0; i < count; i++) {
345        m_sizedButtons[i] = (buttonsValue & (1L << i)) != 0;
346      }
347      m_logButtons.append(m_sizedButtons, timestamp);
348      m_prevButtons.m_available = buttons.m_available;
349      m_prevButtons.m_buttons = buttons.m_buttons;
350    }
351
352    void appendAxes(HALJoystickAxes axes, long timestamp) {
353      int count = availableToCount(axes.m_available);
354      if (m_sizedAxes == null || m_sizedAxes.length != count) {
355        m_sizedAxes = new float[count];
356      }
357      System.arraycopy(axes.m_axes, 0, m_sizedAxes, 0, count);
358      m_logAxes.append(m_sizedAxes, timestamp);
359      m_prevAxes.m_available = axes.m_available;
360      System.arraycopy(axes.m_axes, 0, m_prevAxes.m_axes, 0, count);
361    }
362
363    void appendPOVs(HALJoystickPOVs povs, long timestamp) {
364      int count = availableToCount(povs.m_available);
365      if (m_sizedPOVs == null || m_sizedPOVs.length != count) {
366        m_sizedPOVs = new long[count];
367      }
368      for (int i = 0; i < count; i++) {
369        m_sizedPOVs[i] = povs.m_povs[i];
370      }
371      m_logPOVs.append(m_sizedPOVs, timestamp);
372      m_prevPOVs.m_available = povs.m_available;
373      System.arraycopy(povs.m_povs, 0, m_prevPOVs.m_povs, 0, count);
374    }
375
376    final int m_stick;
377    boolean[] m_sizedButtons;
378    float[] m_sizedAxes;
379    long[] m_sizedPOVs;
380    final HALJoystickButtons m_prevButtons = new HALJoystickButtons();
381    final HALJoystickAxes m_prevAxes = new HALJoystickAxes(DriverStationJNI.MAX_JOYSTICK_AXES);
382    final HALJoystickPOVs m_prevPOVs = new HALJoystickPOVs(DriverStationJNI.MAX_JOYSTICK_POVS);
383    final BooleanArrayLogEntry m_logButtons;
384    final FloatArrayLogEntry m_logAxes;
385    final IntegerArrayLogEntry m_logPOVs;
386  }

388  private static class DataLogSender {
389    DataLogSender(DataLog log, boolean logJoysticks, long timestamp) {
390      m_logControlWord =
391          StructLogEntry.create(log, "DS:controlWord", ControlWord.struct, timestamp);
392
393      // append initial control word value
394      m_logControlWord.append(m_controlWordCache, timestamp);
395      m_oldControlWord.update(m_controlWordCache);
396
397      // append initial opmode value
398      m_logOpMode = new StringLogEntry(log, "DS:opMode", timestamp);
399      m_logOpMode.append(m_opModeCache, timestamp);
400
401      if (logJoysticks) {
402        m_joysticks = new JoystickLogSender[JOYSTICK_PORTS];
403        for (int i = 0; i < JOYSTICK_PORTS; i++) {
404          m_joysticks[i] = new JoystickLogSender(log, i, timestamp);
405        }
406      } else {
407        m_joysticks = new JoystickLogSender[0];
408      }
409    }
410
411    public void send(long timestamp) {
412      // append control word value changes
413      if (!m_controlWordCache.equals(m_oldControlWord)) {
414        // append opmode value changes
415        long opModeId = m_controlWordCache.getOpModeId();
416        if (opModeId != m_oldControlWord.getOpModeId()) {
417          m_logOpMode.append(m_opModeCache, timestamp);
418        }
419
420        m_logControlWord.append(m_controlWordCache, timestamp);
421        m_oldControlWord.update(m_controlWordCache);
422      }
423
424      // append joystick value changes
425      for (JoystickLogSender joystick : m_joysticks) {
426        joystick.send(timestamp);
427      }
428    }
429
430    final ControlWord m_oldControlWord = new ControlWord();
431    final StructLogEntry<ControlWord> m_logControlWord;
432    final StringLogEntry m_logOpMode;
433
434    final JoystickLogSender[] m_joysticks;
435  }

474  private enum JoystickResourceAlert {
475    BUTTON("ButtonUnavailable", "Button"),
476    AXIS("AxisUnavailable", "axis"),
477    POV("POVUnavailable", "POV");
478
479    final String idSuffix;
480    final String label;
481
482    JoystickResourceAlert(String idSuffix, String label) {
483      this.idSuffix = idSuffix;
484      this.label = label;
485    }
486
487    boolean isAvailable(int stick, int resource) {
488      return switch (this) {
489        case BUTTON -> (getStickButtonsAvailable(stick) & (1L << resource)) != 0;
490        case AXIS -> (getStickAxesAvailable(stick) & (1 << resource)) != 0;
491        case POV -> (getStickPOVsAvailable(stick) & (1 << resource)) != 0;
492      };
493    }
494
495    String getText(int stick, int resource) {
496      return "Joystick " + label + " " + resource + " on port " + stick + " not available";
497    }
498  }
499
500  private static final JoystickResourceAlert[] JOYSTICK_RESOURCE_ALERTS =
501      JoystickResourceAlert.values();
502
503  private static final class JoystickAlertState {
504    Alert alert;
505    boolean active;
506  }
507
508  private static final class JoystickAlerts {
509    final int stick;
510    final String connectionText;
511    final JoystickAlertState connectionAlert = new JoystickAlertState();
512    final JoystickAlertState[] resourceAlerts =
513        new JoystickAlertState[JOYSTICK_RESOURCE_ALERTS.length];
514    final JoystickAlertState touchpadFingerAlert = new JoystickAlertState();
515    final int[] resourceAlertValues = new int[JOYSTICK_RESOURCE_ALERTS.length];
516    int touchpadFingerAlertTouchpad;
517    int touchpadFingerAlertFinger;
518    boolean initialized;
519
520    JoystickAlerts(int stick) {
521      this.stick = stick;
522      connectionText =
523          "Joystick on port " + stick + " not available, check if controller is plugged in";
524      for (int i = 0; i < resourceAlerts.length; i++) {
525        resourceAlerts[i] = new JoystickAlertState();
526      }
527      initializeAlerts();
528    }
529
530    boolean initializeAlerts() {
531      closeAlerts();
532
533      Alert newConnectionAlert = null;
534      Alert[] newResourceAlerts = new Alert[JOYSTICK_RESOURCE_ALERTS.length];
535      Alert newTouchpadFingerAlert = null;
536
537      try {
538        newConnectionAlert =
539            new Alert(
540                "DriverStation",
541                "joystick" + stick + "Disconnected",
542                connectionText,
543                Alert.Level.HIGH);
544        for (JoystickResourceAlert resourceAlert : JOYSTICK_RESOURCE_ALERTS) {
545          newResourceAlerts[resourceAlert.ordinal()] =
546              new Alert(
547                  "DriverStation",
548                  "joystick" + stick + resourceAlert.idSuffix,
549                  "",
550                  Alert.Level.MEDIUM);
551        }
552        newTouchpadFingerAlert =
553            new Alert(
554                "DriverStation",
555                "joystick" + stick + "TouchpadFingerUnavailable",
556                "",
557                Alert.Level.MEDIUM);
558      } catch (AlertException ex) {
559        closeAlert(newConnectionAlert);
560        for (Alert alert : newResourceAlerts) {
561          closeAlert(alert);
562        }
563        closeAlert(newTouchpadFingerAlert);
564        initialized = false;
565        return false;
566      }
567
568      connectionAlert.alert = newConnectionAlert;
569      for (JoystickResourceAlert resourceAlert : JOYSTICK_RESOURCE_ALERTS) {
570        resourceAlerts[resourceAlert.ordinal()].alert = newResourceAlerts[resourceAlert.ordinal()];
571      }
572      touchpadFingerAlert.alert = newTouchpadFingerAlert;
573      initialized = true;
574      return true;
575    }
576
577    void closeAlerts() {
578      closeAlert(connectionAlert);
579      for (JoystickAlertState alertState : resourceAlerts) {
580        closeAlert(alertState);
581      }
582      closeAlert(touchpadFingerAlert);
583      initialized = false;
584    }
585
586    static void closeAlert(JoystickAlertState alertState) {
587      closeAlert(alertState.alert);
588      alertState.alert = null;
589      alertState.active = false;
590    }
591
592    static void closeAlert(Alert alert) {
593      if (alert == null) {
594        return;
595      }
596
597      try {
598        alert.close();
599      } catch (AlertException ex) {
600        // Ignore stale handles while cleaning up a failed initialization attempt.
601      }
602    }
603
604    boolean prepareForReport() {
605      if (isJoystickConnected(stick)) {
606        setAlert(connectionAlert, false, connectionText, true);
607        return true;
608      }
609
610      clearResourceAlerts();
611      setAlert(connectionAlert, true, connectionText, true);
612      return false;
613    }
614
615    void refresh() {
616      if (!isJoystickConnected(stick)) {
617        clearResourceAlerts();
618        return;
619      }
620
621      if (connectionAlert.active) {
622        setAlert(connectionAlert, false, connectionText, true);
623      }
624
625      for (JoystickResourceAlert resourceAlert : JOYSTICK_RESOURCE_ALERTS) {
626        refreshResourceAlert(resourceAlert);
627      }
628
629      if (touchpadFingerAlert.active
630          && getStickTouchpadFingerAvailable(
631              stick, touchpadFingerAlertTouchpad, touchpadFingerAlertFinger)) {
632        setAlert(touchpadFingerAlert, false);
633      }
634    }
635
636    void clearAllAlerts() {
637      setAlert(connectionAlert, false, connectionText, true);
638      clearResourceAlerts();
639    }
640
641    void clearResourceAlerts() {
642      for (JoystickAlertState alertState : resourceAlerts) {
643        setAlert(alertState, false);
644      }
645      setAlert(touchpadFingerAlert, false);
646    }
647
648    void refreshResourceAlert(JoystickResourceAlert resourceAlert) {
649      int alertIndex = resourceAlert.ordinal();
650      JoystickAlertState alertState = resourceAlerts[alertIndex];
651      if (alertState.active && resourceAlert.isAvailable(stick, resourceAlertValues[alertIndex])) {
652        setAlert(alertState, false);
653      }
654    }
655
656    void reportResourceWarning(JoystickResourceAlert resourceAlert, int resource) {
657      int alertIndex = resourceAlert.ordinal();
658      resourceAlertValues[alertIndex] = resource;
659      setAlert(resourceAlerts[alertIndex], true, resourceAlert.getText(stick, resource), false);
660    }
661
662    void reportTouchpadFingerWarning(int touchpad, int finger) {
663      String text =
664          "Joystick touchpad finger "
665              + finger
666              + " on touchpad "
667              + touchpad
668              + " on port "
669              + stick
670              + " not available";
671      touchpadFingerAlertTouchpad = touchpad;
672      touchpadFingerAlertFinger = finger;
673      setAlert(touchpadFingerAlert, true, text, false);
674    }
675
676    boolean applyAlert(
677        JoystickAlertState alertState, boolean active, String text, boolean verifyActive) {
678      if (alertState.alert == null) {
679        return false;
680      }
681
682      try {
683        if (active && !text.isEmpty()) {
684          alertState.alert.setText(text);
685        }
686        alertState.alert.set(active);
687        return !active || !verifyActive || alertState.alert.get();
688      } catch (AlertException ex) {
689        return false;
690      }
691    }
692
693    boolean setAlert(JoystickAlertState alertState, boolean active) {
694      return setAlert(alertState, active, "", false);
695    }
696
697    boolean setAlert(
698        JoystickAlertState alertState, boolean active, String text, boolean verifyActive) {
699      if (!active && !alertState.active) {
700        return true;
701      }
702
703      if (active && !initialized && !initializeAlerts()) {
704        return false;
705      }
706
707      if (!applyAlert(alertState, active, text, verifyActive)) {
708        if (!active) {
709          alertState.active = false;
710          return true;
711        }
712        if (!initializeAlerts()) {
713          return false;
714        }
715        if (!applyAlert(alertState, active, text, verifyActive)) {
716          return false;
717        }
718      }
719      alertState.active = active;
720      return true;
721    }
722  }

800  private static void reportErrorImpl(boolean isError, int code, String error, boolean printTrace) {
801    reportErrorImpl(isError, code, error, printTrace, Thread.currentThread().getStackTrace(), 3);
802  }
803
804  private static void reportErrorImpl(
805      boolean isError, int code, String error, StackTraceElement[] stackTrace) {
806    reportErrorImpl(isError, code, error, true, stackTrace, 0);
807  }
808
809  private static void reportErrorImpl(
810      boolean isError,
811      int code,
812      String error,
813      boolean printTrace,
814      StackTraceElement[] stackTrace,
815      int stackTraceFirst) {
816    String locString;
817    if (stackTrace.length >= stackTraceFirst + 1) {
818      locString = stackTrace[stackTraceFirst].toString();
819    } else {
820      locString = "";
821    }
822    StringBuilder traceString = new StringBuilder();
823    if (printTrace) {
824      boolean haveLoc = false;
825      for (int i = stackTraceFirst; i < stackTrace.length; i++) {
826        String loc = stackTrace[i].toString();
827        traceString.append("\tat ").append(loc).append('\n');
828        // get first user function
829        if (!haveLoc && !loc.startsWith("org.wpilib")) {
830          locString = loc;
831          haveLoc = true;
832        }
833      }
834    }
835    DriverStationJNI.sendError(isError, code, error, locString, traceString.toString(), true);
836  }
837
838  /**
839   * Report crash to Driver Station. Appends provided stack trace to crash message.
840   *
841   * @param error The error message
842   * @param stackTrace The stack trace to append
843   */
844  public static void reportCrash(String error, StackTraceElement[] stackTrace) {
845    reportCrashImpl(error, stackTrace, 0);
846  }
847
848  private static void reportCrashImpl(
849      String error, StackTraceElement[] stackTrace, int stackTraceFirst) {
850    String locString;
851    if (stackTrace.length >= stackTraceFirst + 1) {
852      locString = stackTrace[stackTraceFirst].toString();
853    } else {
854      locString = "";
855    }
856    StringBuilder traceString = new StringBuilder();
857    boolean haveLoc = false;
858    for (int i = stackTraceFirst; i < stackTrace.length; i++) {
859      String loc = stackTrace[i].toString();
860      traceString.append("\tat ").append(loc).append('\n');
861      // get first user function
862      if (!haveLoc && !loc.startsWith("org.wpilib")) {
863        locString = loc;
864        haveLoc = true;
865      }
866    }
867    DriverStationJNI.sendProgramCrash(error, locString, traceString.toString());
868    // Sleep to ensure message is sent before crash
869    try {
870      Thread.sleep(100);
871    } catch (InterruptedException e) {
872      Thread.currentThread().interrupt();
873    }
874  }

876  /**
877   * The state of one joystick button.
878   *
879   * @param stick The joystick to read.
880   * @param button The button index.
881   * @return The state of the joystick button.
882   */
883  public static boolean getStickButton(final int stick, final int button) {
884    if (stick < 0 || stick >= JOYSTICK_PORTS) {
885      throw new IllegalArgumentException("Joystick index is out of range, should be 0-5");
886    }
887    if (button < 0 || button >= DriverStationJNI.MAX_JOYSTICK_BUTTONS) {
888      throw new IllegalArgumentException("Joystick Button is out of range");
889    }
890
891    long mask = 1L << button;
892
893    m_cacheDataMutex.lock();
894    try {
895      if ((m_joystickButtons[stick].m_available & mask) != 0) {
896        return (m_joystickButtons[stick].m_buttons & mask) != 0;
897      }
898    } finally {
899      m_cacheDataMutex.unlock();
900    }
901
902    reportJoystickResourceWarning(stick, JoystickResourceAlert.BUTTON, button);
903    return false;
904  }

906  /**
907   * The state of one joystick button if available.
908   *
909   * @param stick The joystick to read.
910   * @param button The button index.
911   * @return The state of the joystick button, or false if the button is not available.
912   */
913  public static Optional<Boolean> getStickButtonIfAvailable(final int stick, final int button) {
914    if (stick < 0 || stick >= JOYSTICK_PORTS) {
915      throw new IllegalArgumentException("Joystick index is out of range, should be 0-5");
916    }
917    if (button < 0 || button >= DriverStationJNI.MAX_JOYSTICK_BUTTONS) {
918      throw new IllegalArgumentException("Joystick Button is out of range");
919    }
920
921    long mask = 1L << button;
922
923    m_cacheDataMutex.lock();
924    try {
925      if ((m_joystickButtons[stick].m_available & mask) != 0) {
926        return Optional.of((m_joystickButtons[stick].m_buttons & mask) != 0);
927      }
928    } finally {
929      m_cacheDataMutex.unlock();
930    }
931    return Optional.empty();
932  }

934  /**
935   * Whether one joystick button was pressed since the last check.
936   *
937   * @param stick The joystick to read.
938   * @param button The button index.
939   * @return Whether the joystick button was pressed since the last check.
940   */
941  public static boolean getStickButtonPressed(final int stick, final int button) {
942    if (stick < 0 || stick >= JOYSTICK_PORTS) {
943      throw new IllegalArgumentException("Joystick index is out of range, should be 0-5");
944    }
945    if (button < 0 || button >= DriverStationJNI.MAX_JOYSTICK_BUTTONS) {
946      throw new IllegalArgumentException("Joystick Button is out of range");
947    }
948
949    long mask = 1L << button;
950
951    m_cacheDataMutex.lock();
952    try {
953      if ((m_joystickButtons[stick].m_available & mask) != 0) {
954        // If button was pressed, clear flag and return true
955        if ((m_joystickButtonsPressed[stick] & mask) != 0) {
956          m_joystickButtonsPressed[stick] &= ~mask;
957          return true;
958        } else {
959          return false;
960        }
961      }
962    } finally {
963      m_cacheDataMutex.unlock();
964    }
965
966    reportJoystickResourceWarning(stick, JoystickResourceAlert.BUTTON, button);
967    return false;
968  }

1037  /**
1038   * Get the state of a touchpad finger on the joystick.
1039   *
1040   * @param stick The joystick to read.
1041   * @param touchpad The touchpad to read.
1042   * @param finger The finger to read.
1043   * @return the state of the touchpad finger.
1044   */
1045  public static TouchpadFinger getStickTouchpadFinger(int stick, int touchpad, int finger) {
1046    if (stick < 0 || stick >= JOYSTICK_PORTS) {
1047      throw new IllegalArgumentException("Joystick index is out of range, should be 0-5");
1048    }
1049    if (touchpad < 0 || touchpad >= DriverStationJNI.MAX_JOYSTICK_TOUCHPADS) {
1050      throw new IllegalArgumentException("Joystick touchpad is out of range");
1051    }
1052    if (finger < 0 || finger >= DriverStationJNI.MAX_JOYSTICK_TOUCHPAD_FINGERS) {
1053      throw new IllegalArgumentException("Joystick touchpad finger is out of range");
1054    }
1055
1056    int touchpadCount;
1057    m_cacheDataMutex.lock();
1058    try {
1059      touchpadCount = m_joystickTouchpads[stick].m_count;
1060      if (touchpad < touchpadCount) {
1061        HALJoystickTouchpad tp = m_joystickTouchpads[stick].m_touchpads[touchpad];
1062        if (finger < tp.m_count) {
1063          return new TouchpadFinger(
1064              tp.m_fingers[finger].m_down, tp.m_fingers[finger].m_x, tp.m_fingers[finger].m_y);
1065        }
1066      }
1067    } finally {
1068      m_cacheDataMutex.unlock();
1069    }
1070
1071    reportJoystickTouchpadFingerWarning(stick, touchpad, finger);
1072    return new TouchpadFinger(false, 0.0f, 0.0f);
1073  }

1314    }
1315
1316    return DriverStationJNI.getJoystickSupportedOutputs((byte) stick);
1317  }

1515  private static int convertColorToInt(Color color) {
1516    if (color == null) {
1517      return -1;
1518    }
1519    return (((int) (color.red * 255) & 0xff) << 16)
1520        | (((int) (color.green * 255) & 0xff) << 8)
1521        | ((int) (color.blue * 255) & 0xff);
1522  }

1524  /**
1525   * Adds an operating mode option. It's necessary to call publishOpModes() to make the added modes
1526   * visible to the driver station.
1527   *
1528   * @param mode robot mode
1529   * @param name name of the operating mode
1530   * @param group group of the operating mode
1531   * @param description description of the operating mode
1532   * @param textColor text color, or null for default
1533   * @param backgroundColor background color, or null for default
1534   * @return unique ID used to later identify the operating mode
1535   * @throws IllegalArgumentException if name is empty or an operating mode with the same robot mode
1536   *     and name already exists
1537   */
1538  @SuppressWarnings("PMD.UseStringBufferForStringAppends")
1539  public static long addOpMode(
1540      RobotMode mode,
1541      String name,
1542      String group,
1543      String description,
1544      Color textColor,
1545      Color backgroundColor) {
1546    if (name.isBlank()) {
1547      throw new IllegalArgumentException("OpMode name must be non-blank");
1548    }
1549    // find unique ID
1550    m_opModesMutex.lock();
1551    try {
1552      String nameCopy = name;
1553      for (; ; ) {
1554        long id = OpModeOption.makeId(mode, nameCopy.hashCode());
1555        OpModeOption existing = m_opModes.get(id);
1556        if (existing == null) {
1557          m_opModes.put(
1558              id,
1559              new OpModeOption(
1560                  id,
1561                  name,
1562                  group,
1563                  description,
1564                  convertColorToInt(textColor),
1565                  convertColorToInt(backgroundColor)));
1566          return id;
1567        }
1568        if (existing.getMode() == mode && existing.name.equals(name)) {
1569          // already exists
1570          throw new IllegalArgumentException("OpMode " + name + " already exists for mode " + mode);
1571        }
1572        // collision, try again with space appended
1573        nameCopy += ' ';
1574      }
1575    } finally {
1576      m_opModesMutex.unlock();
1577    }
1578  }
1579

1590   *     already exists
1591   */
1592  public static long addOpMode(RobotMode mode, String name, String group, String description) {

1594  }

1613   * visible to the driver station.

1625  /**
1626   * Removes an operating mode option. It's necessary to call publishOpModes() to make the removed
1627   * mode no longer visible to the driver station.
1628   *
1629   * @param mode robot mode
1630   * @param name name of the operating mode
1631   * @return unique ID for the opmode, or 0 if not found
1632   */
1633  public static long removeOpMode(RobotMode mode, String name) {
1634    if (name.isBlank()) {
1635      return 0;
1636    }
1637    m_opModesMutex.lock();
1638    try {
1639      // we have to loop over all entries to find the one with the correct name
1640      // because the of the unique ID generation scheme
1641      for (OpModeOption opMode : m_opModes.values()) {
1642        if (opMode.getMode() == mode && opMode.name.equals(name)) {
1643          m_opModes.remove(opMode.id);
1644          return opMode.id;
1645        }
1646      }
1647    } finally {
1648      m_opModesMutex.unlock();
1649    }
1650    return 0;
1651  }
1652
1653  /** Publishes the operating mode options to the driver station. */
1654  public static void publishOpModes() {
1655    m_opModesMutex.lock();
1656    try {
1657      OpModeOption[] options = new OpModeOption[m_opModes.size()];
1658      DriverStationJNI.setOpModeOptions(m_opModes.values().toArray(options));
1659    } finally {
1660      m_opModesMutex.unlock();
1661    }
1662
1663    var modeCounts =
1664        m_opModes.values().stream()
1665            .collect(Collectors.groupingBy(OpModeOption::getMode, Collectors.counting()));
1666
1667    for (RobotMode mode : RobotMode.values()) {
1668      UsageReporting.reportUsage(
1669          "OpMode/" + mode, String.valueOf(modeCounts.getOrDefault(mode, 0L)));
1670    }
1671  }
1672
1673  /** Clears all operating mode options and publishes an empty list to the driver station. */
1674  public static void clearOpModes() {
1675    m_opModesMutex.lock();
1676    try {
1677      m_opModes.clear();
1678      DriverStationJNI.setOpModeOptions(new OpModeOption[0]);
1679    } finally {
1680      m_opModesMutex.unlock();
1681    }
1682  }

1684  /**
1685   * Sets the program starting flag in the DS. This will also allow {@link #getOpModeId()} and
1686   * {@link #getOpMode()} to return values for the selected OpMode in the DS application, if the DS
1687   * is connected by the time this method is called.
1688   *
1689   * <p>Most users will not need to use this method; the {@link TimedRobot} and {@link OpModeRobot}
1690   * robot framework classes will call it automatically after the main robot class is instantiated.
1691   * However, teams using the commandsv3 library and a custom main robot class need to be careful to
1692   * only call this method after all mechanisms and global trigger bindings are set up. If not, any
1693   * setup performed in the main robot class may be incorrectly bound to the opmode selected in the
1694   * DS if it's connected by the time the robot program boots up.
1695   *
1696   * <p>This is what changes the DS to showing robot code ready.
1697   *
1698   * @see #getOpMode()
1699   * @see #getOpModeId()
1700   */
1701  public static void observeUserProgramStarting() {
1702    m_userProgramStarted = true;
1703    DriverStationJNI.observeUserProgramStarting();
1704  }

1706  /**
1707   * For internal unit testing in WPILib. Not for team use. Has no effect unless called in
1708   * simulation mode.
1709   *
1710   * <p>Resets the {@code m_userProgramStarted} flag for unit tests. Does not reset anything in the
1711   * JNI layer.
1712   */
1713  public static void clearUserProgramStarted() {
1714    if (!RobotBase.isSimulation()) {
1715      // NOP unless running in sim. We don't want teams to call this; it would prevent their
1716      // programs from transitioning between modes and from detecting opmode selections.
1717      reportWarning(
1718          "DriverStationBackend.clearUserProgramStarted() was called! "
1719              + "This method exists solely for internal WPILib unit tests "
1720              + "and does nothing in team code.",
1721          true);
1722      return;
1723    }
1724
1725    m_userProgramStarted = false;
1726  }

1732   * auto period ends, this will change to reflect the operating mode selected for teleop.

1955   * @return the location of the team's driver station controls: 1, 2, or 3
1956   */
1957  public static OptionalInt getLocation() {
1958    AllianceStationID allianceStationID = DriverStationJNI.getAllianceStation();
1959    if (allianceStationID == null) {
1960      allianceStationID = AllianceStationID.UNKNOWN;
1961    }
1962
1963    return m_stationMap.get(allianceStationID);
1964  }

1978  /**
1979   * Return the approximate match time. The FMS does not send an official match time to the robots,
1980   * but does send an approximate match time. The value will count down the time remaining in the
1981   * current period (auto or teleop). Warning: This is not an official time (so it cannot be used to
1982   * dispute ref calls or guarantee that a function will trigger before the match ends).
1983   *
1984   * <p>When connected to the real field, this number only changes in full integer increments, and
1985   * always counts down.
1986   *
1987   * <p>When the DS is in practice mode, this number is a floating point number, and counts down.
1988   *
1989   * <p>When the DS is in teleop or autonomous mode, this number returns -1.0.
1990   *
1991   * <p>Simulation matches DS behavior without an FMS connected.
1992   *
1993   * @return Time remaining in current match period (auto or teleop) in seconds
1994   */
1995  public static double getMatchTime() {

1999  /**
2000   * Allows the user to specify whether they want joystick connection alerts to be shown. This
2001   * setting is ignored when the FMS is connected -- alerts will always be on in that scenario.
2002   *
2003   * @param silence Whether joystick connection alerts should be silenced.
2004   */
2005  public static void silenceJoystickConnectionAlert(boolean silence) {
2006    m_joystickAlertMutex.lock();
2007    try {
2008      m_silenceJoystickAlerts = silence;
2009      if (silence && !isFMSAttached()) {
2010        clearJoystickAlertsLocked();
2011      }
2012    } finally {
2013      m_joystickAlertMutex.unlock();
2014    }
2015  }

2017  /**
2018   * Returns whether joystick connection alerts are silenced. This will always return false when
2019   * connected to the FMS.
2020   *
2021   * @return Whether joystick connection alerts are silenced.
2022   */
2023  public static boolean isJoystickConnectionAlertSilenced() {
2024    m_joystickAlertMutex.lock();
2025    try {
2026      return !isFMSAttached() && m_silenceJoystickAlerts;
2027    } finally {
2028      m_joystickAlertMutex.unlock();
2029    }
2030  }

2046  /**
2047   * Copy data from the DS task for the user. If no new data exists, it will just be returned,
2048   * otherwise the data will be copied from the DS polling loop.
2049   */
2050  public static void refreshData() {
2051    DriverStationJNI.refreshDSData();
2052
2053    // Get the status of all the joysticks
2054    for (byte stick = 0; stick < JOYSTICK_PORTS; stick++) {
2055      DriverStationJNI.getAllJoystickData(
2056          stick,
2057          m_joystickAxesCache[stick].m_axes,
2058          m_joystickAxesRawCache[stick].m_axes,
2059          m_joystickPOVsCache[stick].m_povs,
2060          m_touchpadFingersCache,
2061          m_metadataCache);
2062      m_joystickAxesCache[stick].m_available = (int) m_metadataCache[0];
2063      m_joystickAxesRawCache[stick].m_available = (int) m_metadataCache[0];
2064      m_joystickPOVsCache[stick].m_available = (int) m_metadataCache[1];
2065      m_joystickButtonsCache[stick].m_available = m_metadataCache[2];
2066      m_joystickButtonsCache[stick].m_buttons = m_metadataCache[3];
2067      m_joystickTouchpadsCache[stick].m_count = (int) m_metadataCache[4];
2068      for (int i = 0; i < m_joystickTouchpadsCache[stick].m_count; i++) {
2069        long metadata = m_metadataCache[5 + i];
2070        m_joystickTouchpadsCache[stick].m_touchpads[i].m_fingers[0].m_down = (metadata & 0x1) != 0;
2071        m_joystickTouchpadsCache[stick].m_touchpads[i].m_fingers[1].m_down = (metadata & 0x2) != 0;
2072        m_joystickTouchpadsCache[stick].m_touchpads[i].m_count = (int) (metadata >> 2 & 0x3);
2073        for (int j = 0; j < m_joystickTouchpadsCache[stick].m_touchpads[i].m_count; j++) {
2074          m_joystickTouchpadsCache[stick].m_touchpads[i].m_fingers[j].m_x =
2075              m_touchpadFingersCache[i * 4 + j * 2 + 0];
2076          m_joystickTouchpadsCache[stick].m_touchpads[i].m_fingers[j].m_y =
2077              m_touchpadFingersCache[i * 4 + j * 2 + 1];
2078        }
2079      }
2080    }
2081
2082    DriverStationJNI.getMatchInfo(m_matchInfoCache);
2083
2084    // This is a pass through, so if it hasn't changed, it doesn't
2085    // reallocate
2086    m_gameDataCache = DriverStationJNI.getGameData(m_gameDataCache);
2087
2088    DriverStationJNI.getControlWord(m_controlWordCache);
2089
2090    m_opModeCache = opModeToString(m_controlWordCache.getOpModeId());
2091
2092    DataLogSender dataLogSender;
2093    // lock joystick mutex to swap cache data
2094    m_cacheDataMutex.lock();
2095    try {
2096      for (int i = 0; i < JOYSTICK_PORTS; i++) {
2097        // If buttons weren't pressed and are now, set flags in m_buttonsPressed
2098        m_joystickButtonsPressed[i] |=
2099            ~m_joystickButtons[i].m_buttons & m_joystickButtonsCache[i].m_buttons;
2100
2101        // If buttons were pressed and aren't now, set flags in m_buttonsReleased
2102        m_joystickButtonsReleased[i] |=
2103            m_joystickButtons[i].m_buttons & ~m_joystickButtonsCache[i].m_buttons;
2104      }
2105
2106      // move cache to actual data
2107      HALJoystickAxes[] currentAxes = m_joystickAxes;
2108      m_joystickAxes = m_joystickAxesCache;
2109      m_joystickAxesCache = currentAxes;
2110
2111      HALJoystickAxesRaw[] currentAxesRaw = m_joystickAxesRaw;
2112      m_joystickAxesRaw = m_joystickAxesRawCache;
2113      m_joystickAxesRawCache = currentAxesRaw;
2114
2115      HALJoystickButtons[] currentButtons = m_joystickButtons;
2116      m_joystickButtons = m_joystickButtonsCache;
2117      m_joystickButtonsCache = currentButtons;
2118
2119      HALJoystickPOVs[] currentPOVs = m_joystickPOVs;
2120      m_joystickPOVs = m_joystickPOVsCache;
2121      m_joystickPOVsCache = currentPOVs;
2122
2123      HALJoystickTouchpads[] currentTouchpads = m_joystickTouchpads;
2124      m_joystickTouchpads = m_joystickTouchpadsCache;
2125      m_joystickTouchpadsCache = currentTouchpads;
2126
2127      MatchInfoData currentInfo = m_matchInfo;
2128      m_matchInfo = m_matchInfoCache;
2129      m_matchInfoCache = currentInfo;
2130
2131      m_gameData = m_gameDataCache;
2132
2133      ControlWord currentWord = m_controlWord;
2134      m_controlWord = m_controlWordCache;
2135      m_controlWordCache = currentWord;
2136
2137      String currentOpMode = m_opMode;
2138      m_opMode = m_opModeCache;
2139      m_opModeCache = currentOpMode;
2140
2141      dataLogSender = m_dataLogSender;
2142    } finally {
2143      m_cacheDataMutex.unlock();
2144    }
2145
2146    clearJoystickAlerts();
2147
2148    m_refreshEvents.wakeup();
2149
2150    m_matchDataSender.sendMatchData();
2151    if (dataLogSender != null) {
2152      dataLogSender.send(WPIUtilJNI.now());
2153    }
2154  }

2174  private static JoystickAlerts getJoystickAlertsLocked(int stick) {
2175    JoystickAlerts alerts = m_joystickAlerts[stick];
2176    if (alerts == null) {
2177      alerts = new JoystickAlerts(stick);
2178      m_joystickAlerts[stick] = alerts;
2179    }
2180    return alerts;
2181  }

2183  private static void reportJoystickResourceWarning(
2184      int stick, JoystickResourceAlert resourceAlert, int resource) {
2185    m_joystickAlertMutex.lock();
2186    try {
2187      if (!isFMSAttached() && m_silenceJoystickAlerts) {
2188        return;
2189      }
2190
2191      JoystickAlerts alerts = getJoystickAlertsLocked(stick);
2192      if (!alerts.prepareForReport()) {
2193        return;
2194      }
2195
2196      alerts.reportResourceWarning(resourceAlert, resource);
2197    } finally {
2198      m_joystickAlertMutex.unlock();
2199    }
2200  }
2201
2202  private static void reportJoystickTouchpadFingerWarning(int stick, int touchpad, int finger) {
2203    m_joystickAlertMutex.lock();
2204    try {
2205      if (!isFMSAttached() && m_silenceJoystickAlerts) {
2206        return;
2207      }
2208
2209      JoystickAlerts alerts = getJoystickAlertsLocked(stick);
2210      if (!alerts.prepareForReport()) {
2211        return;
2212      }
2213
2214      alerts.reportTouchpadFingerWarning(touchpad, finger);
2215    } finally {
2216      m_joystickAlertMutex.unlock();
2217    }
2218  }
2219
2220  private static void clearJoystickAlerts() {
2221    m_joystickAlertMutex.lock();
2222    try {
2223      clearJoystickAlertsLocked();
2224    } finally {
2225      m_joystickAlertMutex.unlock();
2226    }
2227  }
2228
2229  private static void clearJoystickAlertsLocked() {
2230    if (!isFMSAttached() && m_silenceJoystickAlerts) {
2231      for (JoystickAlerts alerts : m_joystickAlerts) {
2232        if (alerts != null) {
2233          alerts.clearAllAlerts();
2234        }
2235      }
2236      return;
2237    }
2238
2239    for (JoystickAlerts alerts : m_joystickAlerts) {
2240      if (alerts != null) {
2241        alerts.refresh();
2242      }
2243    }
2244  }

2246  /**
2247   * Starts logging DriverStation data to data log. Repeated calls are ignored.
2248   *
2249   * @param log data log
2250   * @param logJoysticks if true, log joystick data
2251   */
2252  @SuppressWarnings("PMD.NonThreadSafeSingleton")
2253  public static void startDataLog(DataLog log, boolean logJoysticks) {
2254    m_cacheDataMutex.lock();
2255    try {
2256      if (m_dataLogSender == null) {
2257        m_dataLogSender = new DataLogSender(log, logJoysticks, WPIUtilJNI.now());
2258      }
2259    } finally {
2260      m_cacheDataMutex.unlock();
2261    }
2262  }

2270  public static void startDataLog(DataLog log) {
